Impressed with the mango smoothie
Aug 2026 • Family
Although I hadn't made a reservation, perhaps because there were many seats, there were many people waiting, but since they were being seated one after another, I was able to enter in about 15 minutes. Instead of the noisy outside, I was shown to a quiet seat on the second floor.
The staff's service was good, and the drinks and food arrived quickly.
I was impressed by the mango smoothie.
I drank two cups.
I ordered pineapple juice at other various places too, but this one was the most delicious.
I ordered various things, but none were a miss.
My favorite dish was the pineapple fried rice. A little sweet, and different from Chinese fried rice, but delicious.
The price was cheaper than I expected.
Among several Vietnamese restaurants that Japanese tourists often visit on this trip
By far.
Highly recommended for those visiting Da Nang and Hoi An in Vietnam for the first time.

Had a really enjoyable experience at An Thoi Hoi An. The location is excellent, right inside the Ancient Town, making it a great place to stop during a walk around Hoi An.

The restaurant has a modern but cozy atmosphere, with plenty of space and a nice open feeling. The food looked beautiful and we ordered many dishes to share — everything arrived fresh and full of flavor.

What I appreciated most was the overall experience rather than just the food itself: the atmosphere, the presentation, the location, and even the complimentary coffee voucher nearby helped make the lunch feel like part of the whole Hoi An experience.

Very good service, friendly staff, and overall a great spot for visitors looking for a nice meal in the center of Hoi An.
